title: GEMglMaterialfv
description: specify material parameters for the lighting model

messages.description: which face or faces are being updated
material parameter to set, e.g. GL_SHININESS or GL_DIFFUSE
list of values for the material parameter

arguments.description: list of values for the material parameter

body: [GEMglMaterialfv] calls glMaterialfv() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. GL constants are numbers here: [GLdefine] turns a name like GL_LINES into its value. See glMaterial in the OpenGL reference.
